page.title: Plan
page.purpose: Project one record set through Day, Week, Month, Agenda, Timeline, Capacity, and Commitments perspectives so the user can place work, inspect load, and review promises without seven separate stores.

priorities.statement: Fixed, flexible, date-assigned, and unscheduled work are visually distinct, and moving one item never silently moves other accepted items.
priorities.notes: The gesture authorizes that move, not a global optimization (plan §8.3).

priorities.statement: Filtering the visible items never removes hidden obligations from feasibility — capacity stays aware of all authorized busy time.
A proposal preview shows original vs proposed geometry, locks, changed demand, remaining conflicts, and affected commitments before any apply.
Every perspective is fully usable with a keyboard and screen reader; Agenda is the accessible equivalent of the Timeline.

states.description: The selected range loads; existing accepted placements render before proposals.
The chosen perspective shows the record set with truthful time geometry and distinct item kinds.
No scheduled items in range: show the empty window with capture and routine affordances.
A proposal is pending review: original and proposed placements are both shown, labeled.
A proposal became stale (input changed): keep it inspectable and offer to regenerate.
A range query failed: keep the last-known accepted schedule visible with a retry.
